Welcome back! DOGE alumni got inside Anthropic through its vendors, Google taught a model to sleep, and Alibaba built an audio model that never finishes a sentence.  In today's Atlas Newsletter: Anthropic bought a drug company with one employee: Claude coordinated 11 outside labs for a solo founder, and a muscular dystrophy candidate reached promising results in mice in 18 months. Anthropic got breached and ChatGPT got your inbox: The hardened systems held. The HR software gave up salary details and Slack messages in under 12 hours. Google’s new model dreams on purpose: A wake phase, a consolidation phase and a dreaming phase, with near-perfect recall out to 10M tokens. Alibaba’s new audio model never finishes a sentence: Qwen-Audio-Jev reads the decision straight off the decoder’s hidden state and decodes zero tokens. PS: Want to collaborate with the biggest GTM engine and distribution moat for AI companies? You can feature your tool with us and reach millions. Anthropic bought a drug company with one employee Cody Tranbarger ran a biotech alone.  Claude handled the coordination across 11 outside labs, juggling contracts and test schedules, and a muscular dystrophy candidate went from idea to promising results in mice in under 18 months.  Human trials could start as late as 2028. Tranbarger calls the setup a “Pipeline-in-a-Person,” and also turned out to be Professor Oak, a biotech account run pseudonymously on X for six years. Anthropic acquired the company and is now running its own drug discovery programs, alongside its own wet lab. The partner results came out at the same time. At Generate Biomedicines, six scientists had Claude Code redesign part of a CAR T therapy, which reprograms a patient’s immune cells to hunt tumors.  One design came out roughly 70% shorter than the standard, and in lab tests produced about 10 times as many of the proteins immune cells use to find cancer.  The compression matters because Generate wants CAR T to work on solid tumors, which means fitting in more instructions. Nobody has tested the short version in an animal or a person. At Divergence Labs, Claude designed about 35,000 antibodies for a food allergy drug in a month, mostly unsupervised. 81552.subject: Robinhood Lists Tokens of OKXICE Objectors
81552.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* [**DTCC**](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/dtcc-s-tokenization-service-goes-live-with-34-securities)[ opened tokenization with 34 securities](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/dtcc-s-tokenization-service-goes-live-with-34-securities)

* [**Kamino**](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/kamino-opens-usdc-loans-against-backpack-tokenized-stocks)[ lends USDC against tokenized stocks](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/kamino-opens-usdc-loans-against-backpack-tokenized-stocks)

* [**Aave**](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/aave-raises-bitcoin-and-ether-collateral-borrowing-limits-across-v3-and-v4)[ raised BTC and ETH borrowing limits](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/aave-raises-bitcoin-and-ether-collateral-borrowing-limits-across-v3-and-v4)

* [**A Tranche Vault**](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/tranche-vault-on-avalanche-drained-of-1-01-million-usdc)[ lost 1.01M USDC on Avalanche](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/tranche-vault-on-avalanche-drained-of-1-01-million-usdc)

* [**Stellar**](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/stellar-unveils-fee-free-network-processing-7-million-transactions-per-second)[ tested a fee-free chain at 7M payments/sec](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/stellar-unveils-fee-free-network-processing-7-million-transactions-per-second)

JPMorgan Chase objected to having its stock traded as a token on OKXICE. Today Robinhood listed a JPMorgan token on its own chain. By 3:56 p.m. ET, holders had 96 of them, worth about $33,000.

OKXICE is a planned venue from the crypto exchange OKX and Intercontinental Exchange, which owns the New York Stock Exchange. OKXICE would trade tokenized U.S. stocks under an exemption the SEC granted in September. Its Oct. 27 notice [lists objections from 33 companies](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/okxice-objections-rise-to-33-as-stock-token-lineup-shrinks), with JPMorgan among the seven added that day. Robinhood [added eight stock and ETF tokens to Robinhood Chain](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/robinhood-adds-eight-stock-and-etf-tokens-to-its-chain) today, including JPMorgan and McDonald's, another objector. Can a company stop its stock from becoming a token?

Under the SEC's order, a company can block its stock on a U.S. venue that uses the exemption. On Sept. 17, we wrote that [a written objection filed by day 30 bars the listing outright](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/sec-innovation-exemption-tokenized-stocks-cftc-software-relief). OKXICE had [nine objectors by Oct. 15](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/coreweave-broadcom-join-objections-to-okx-ice-stock-tokenization). By Oct. 27, objections covered [31 of the 63 symbols](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/tokenized-stock-and-etf-roster-ondo-dtcc-and-okxice) it first proposed.
